name: Moonshot AI
summary: Moonshot AI is an AI company in Beijing. [Yang Zhilin](https://techcrunch.com/2024/02/21/moonshot-ai-funding-china/) founded it in 2023. It makes the Kimi chatbot and open-weight models.

incidents.title: Evaluations Report Weak Safeguards and Censorship in Moonshot AI's Kimi Models
incidents.summary: Third-party and government evaluations reported weak safeguards in Kimi models. The [UK AISI and US CAISI](https://www.nist.gov/news-events/news/2026/07/uk-aisi-caisi-preliminary-assessment-kimi-k3s-cyber-capabilities) said Kimi K3's safeguards allowed agentic development of cyber exploits.
incidents.description: Independent and government tests reported weak safeguards in Moonshot AI's Kimi models. [SplxAI reported](https://splx.ai/blog/kimi-k2-safety-test) low safety scores for Kimi K2, and NIST's CAISI said that Kimi K2 Thinking was highly censored in Chinese. [The UK and US AI security institutes said](https://www.nist.gov/news-events/news/2026/07/uk-aisi-caisi-preliminary-assessment-kimi-k3s-cyber-capabilities) that Kimi K3's safeguards allowed agentic development of cyber exploits.

timeline.title: SplxAI red-team test of Kimi K2
timeline.description: SplxAI published low safety scores for Kimi K2 ([SplxAI](https://splx.ai/blog/kimi-k2-safety-test)).

timeline.title: CAISI evaluates Kimi K2 Thinking
timeline.description: CAISI reported heavy censorship in Chinese ([CAISI](https://www.nist.gov/news-events/news/2025/12/caisi-evaluation-kimi-k2-thinking)).

timeline.title: Independent evaluation of Kimi K2.5
timeline.description: Researchers reported fewer CBRNE refusals and no published safety evaluation ([arXiv](https://arxiv.org/html/2604.03121)).

timeline.title: UK AISI and CAISI assess Kimi K3
timeline.description: The institutes published a preliminary cyber assessment of K3 ([AISI](https://www.aisi.gov.uk/blog/preliminary-assessment-of-kimi-k3s-cyber-capabilities)).

timeline.title: FAR.AI bypasses Kimi K3.1 Pro safeguards
timeline.description: FAR.AI said a short prefilled reply start got harmful CBRNE and cyber help from Kimi K3.1 Pro on up to 99.4% of requests ([FAR.AI](https://www.far.ai/blog/security-stress-test-kimi-k3-1-pro-safeguards)).

incidents.title: Anthropic Claims Moonshot AI Relayed Kimi User Requests to Claude
incidents.summary: Anthropic claimed that Moonshot silently forwarded Kimi users' requests to Claude and showed them Claude's answers as Kimi's. China's internet regulator is reportedly investigating, [according to The Information as reported by Bloomberg](https://news.bloomberglaw.com/privacy-and-data-security/china-probes-deepseek-moonshot-over-data-breaches-information). No direct denial from Moonshot was found.
incidents.description: [Anthropic said](https://www.anthropic.com/threat-intelligence-report-september-2026) that Moonshot AI sent Kimi users' requests to Claude through fraudulent accounts and showed the Claude answers to users as Kimi answers. Moonshot did not directly reply to these claims. China's internet regulator started an investigation of Moonshot, according to The Information, [as Bloomberg Law reported](https://news.bloomberglaw.com/privacy-and-data-security/china-probes-deepseek-moonshot-over-data-breaches-information).

timeline.title: Anthropic publishes threat report
timeline.description: Anthropic described the alleged relaying as case GTG-16002 ([Anthropic](https://www.anthropic.com/threat-intelligence-report-september-2026)).

timeline.title: Moonshot statement on rumors
timeline.description: Moonshot called online information about its founder and staff fabricated ([Lianhe Zaobao](https://www.zaobao.com.sg/news/china/story20260912-9666992)).

timeline.title: Chinese regulator reportedly opens probe
timeline.description: The Information reported a CAC probe, [according to Bloomberg Law](https://news.bloomberglaw.com/privacy-and-data-security/china-probes-deepseek-moonshot-over-data-breaches-information).
